request.task: W0.0: plan-authority verifier runs on CI checkouts; vitest scoped to src; review fixes
request.head: de76d476876f61010691820a81aaa4c47a5bbb65

audit.proof_assessment: In-tree node tests are the actual oracle: they delete GITHUB_ACTIONS for local fail-closed cases, force GITHUB_ACTIONS=true through the mutation helper for record-binding, and run the full verifier with the untracked file removed. The markdown proof is only a command log; its packet prefix 8871ecc2 does not match authority-manifest packetDigest 6abc2156…, so it cannot authenticate hashes. Diff evidence matches the criterion: only T01 validateHashBindings gains !isGithubActions, manifest diff is only /packetDigest, T02 receipt diff is only the three target digests, vitest include is the default filename pattern scoped to src/**, and ENGINE-LEDGER REPO-012 records the unwired source-adoption verifier asserting the 2026-08-31 re-pin.
residual_risks: GITHUB_ACTIONS is a spoofable env var; local operators can skip the untracked-file read (documented in the re-pin). Record digest binding still holds.
T02 preExistingUntrackedBaseline file-read skip is not in the diff; CI-without-baseline is only proven if that path does not sha256 the handoff (the new full-verifier test would fail if it did).
Ledger claim that verify-obx-p180-source-adoption.mjs lines 128-139 now fail is not in this slice.
T02 security receipt is rewritten in place (capturedAt unchanged); integrity depends on the new 2026-09-02 re-pin, not on the original review bytes.
